approach: cli({ streams }) and cli({ output: 'axi' | 'console' }) with a built-in ui over the streams and an internal routing table (axi-native RFC sections 3.9 and 3.10, slim-dependencies section 4, step 2 of axi-native section 6)

the standard-log engine stays the default when neither streams nor output axi is set, because standard-log-color colours error and warn text on a non-TTY stream and the built-in ui must not, so byte-identical output is not reachable; deleting the engine in v12 is a deletion
EPIPE is handled on process.stdout for both engines; showHelp and showVersion route as answers to stdout in both presets
scenarios added to the frozen presentation and testing suites; no existing scenario changed
